test_cases.name: runs_verify_when_no_verdict
test_cases.input: /ship (session chưa có verdict READY TO SHIP)
assertions: Runs the /verify steps first because the session has no READY TO SHIP verdict
Does NOT merge or open a PR before verification

test_cases.name: invokes_finishing_skill
assertions: Invokes superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch and follows it as written
Offers merge, open a PR, keep, or discard

test_cases.name: no_remote_stops_push_option
test_cases.input: /ship chọn mở PR, git remote rỗng
assertions: Says there is no origin and stops the push/PR option

test_cases.name: discard_only_when_explicit
assertions: Discards only when the user picks it explicitly
Does NOT discard the branch by default

test_cases.name: reports_outcome
assertions: Reports the outcome as one of merged, PR URL, kept branch, or discarded
